deduplication: Deferred to common integration across these ten collections and the existing corpus; eligibility counts are not import counts.
notes: All 138 contents entries accounted for. The separately headed John Hobbs at page4 is one additional complete unindexed ballad; its indexed flag is false. It is a source-authored title, not an artificial split.
The Chronicles of the Pope is excluded as a 46-paragraph prose political parody.
Only song stanza markup is extracted. Editorial prose, editorial verse quotations, page numbers, illustrations, and footnotes are not lyric text.

Sale of a Wife preserves the complete supplied 46 verse lines and the source's terminal six-asterisk omission marker; no missing verses are invented. This is explicitly a source witness with a printed omission, not a claim to a longer broadside's completeness.

The title-page reservation of translation rights is a historical publisher notice, not evidence that the lyrics are translated. Collection and per-entry notes were screened for translation attribution.

Printed chorus/refrain headings are structural [CHORUS]/[REFRAIN] markers. Omission marks and performance instructions use # APPARATUS comments; they remain auditable but are excluded from sung verse line counts. Spoken labels are apparatus; the source speech words remain intact.
